title: Delegation
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of delegation using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates delegation.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Delegation** as part of **Inheritance, Interfaces, and Polymorphism**. Delegation forwards selected behavior to another object; composition can reuse behavior without creating a fragile inheritance hierarchy. Use the subtopics—Class Delegation with by, Implementing Interfaces Through Delegation, Composition Versus Inheritance—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
